origin.hostDerivation: m- + first 48 lowercase hexadecimal characters of SHA-256(UTF-8 stable module ID) + .modules.plat.invalid
origin.uniqueness: one origin per stable module ID; different module IDs must never share an origin
origin.assetRoot: only the verified active package root for the session module
origin.fallback: unhandled paths and unknown hosts fail closed; they are not fetched from the network

transport.allowedOriginRule: the exact HTTPS origin assigned to this module; no wildcard or shared module origin
transport.fallbackWhenUnsupported: refuse module launch; do not fall back to addJavascriptInterface or an unrestricted postMessage receiver

directions.hostToModule: helloAck, then response and event messages only

session.handshakeId: UUID generated by the module and echoed by the Host
session.sessionId: UUIDv4 generated by the Host for each WebView document session
session.moduleIdentity: bound by the Host to the verified manifest and active package before navigation; never accepted from message fields
session.staleSession: reject any message whose sessionId does not equal the active session
teardown: WebView destruction or Host process shutdown
module update activation, disablement, or removal
session.closeSemantics: invalidate the session before releasing the WebView; cancel pending work and discard late responses and events

limits.messageEncoding: UTF-8 JSON; size is measured in encoded bytes before parsing

webViewSettings.domStorageIsolation: unique origin per module; clear that origin's data on explicit module removal
webViewSettings.debugging: disabled in release builds; debug builds only
webViewSettings.webPermissions: deny unless a later reviewed capability explicitly grants a specific permission

navigation.topLevel: allow only the exact module origin; a full document navigation closes and re-handshakes the session
navigation.externalUrls: never load in the module WebView; no automatic intent dispatch

network.serviceWorkersAndWorkers: blocked in v1 by CSP worker-src none

contentSecurityPolicy: default-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; object-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'none'; connect-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; media-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; worker-src 'none'

responseHeaders.Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), usb=(), serial=(), payment=(), clipboard-read=(), clipboard-write=()

authorization.identitySource: Host-owned session context bound to verified manifest
requiredChecksPerCall: API method exists in the v1 registry
verified manifest declares the required capability
user consent is currently granted when required
request arrived through the active session bound to this module
authorization.storageNamespace: derive from the Host-owned stable module ID; never accept a storage namespace or module ID from request parameters
